title: Five White Kites
note: b385 — first use of 'kite'. P2's 'worm's-eye viewpoint' is approximated with Fig flat on the ground and the kites drawn large/high rather than a literal low-camera perspective (the kit has no camera-angle mechanism, only placement and scale). P8's 'string wound around his middle three times' reuses the kite's own coiled-string option near Fig's body rather than a separate wrap-around geometry.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow on a breezy hilltop holding five kite strings in his beak and both feet, five white diamond kites climbing above him against a huge pale blue sky. Lots of open air.
pages.alt: Pip stands on a breezy hilltop holding five kite strings, five white diamond kites climbing above him against a huge pale blue sky.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar flat on the grass, gripping a stem with all his legs, staring up at the kites with deep suspicion. Low worm's-eye viewpoint so the kites loom enormous.
pages.alt: Fig lies flat on the grass gripping a stem with all his legs, staring up with deep suspicion at kites that loom enormous above him.

pages.brief: Close two-shot: Pip patient and reasonable, Fig unconvinced with his little face set. One kite string coiling near Fig like a snake, which is clearly why he thinks this.
pages.alt: A close two-shot: Pip patient and reasonable, Fig unconvinced, with one kite string coiling near him like a snake — clearly why he is suspicious.

pages.brief: The kites tiny and far off near the top of the page, strings stretched taut and thrumming, grass flattened below. Pip leaning back hard against the pull. Emphasise wind with bent stems.
pages.alt: The kites are tiny and far off near the top of the page, strings stretched taut, grass flattened below as Pip leans back hard against the pull of the wind.

pages.brief: A snapped string whipping loose and one kite tumbling away over the treetops, getting smaller. Pip's expression stricken. The other four kites still up. Wide open sky.
pages.alt: A snapped string whips loose and one kite tumbles away into the distance over the treetops, getting smaller, while Pip's expression is stricken and the other four kites stay up.

pages.brief: Olive the owl in full flight, wings swept back, absolutely determined, moving faster than an owl of her build should. Streaks of movement. Genuinely impressive and slightly frightening.
pages.alt: Olive the owl flies at full speed, wings swept back, absolutely determined, with streaks of movement behind her — genuinely impressive and slightly frightening.

pages.brief: Olive landing with the muddy kite held in one foot, entirely unruffled, delivering her report. Pip and Fig looking up at her with enormous respect. Comic understatement.
pages.alt: Olive lands with the muddy kite held in one foot, entirely unruffled, delivering her report while Pip and Fig look up at her with enormous respect.

pages.brief: Fig on the grass with one kite string wound firmly around his middle three times, one small white kite bobbing above him, a look of intense concentration and secret delight. Final warm evening light.
pages.alt: Fig sits on the grass with one kite string wound firmly around his middle, a small white kite bobbing above him, intense concentration and secret delight on his face in the final warm evening light.
